sources.snippet: AfriDataHub's repository for developing datasets and NLP resources for Hausa Language. This repository supports the creation of parallel corpora and general language corpora, empowering AI applications that are inclusive and culturally relevant to Hausa Language speakers.

sources.title: HelpMum | Translate 9ja to eng
sources.snippet: The HelpMum Translator 9ja to eng Model is a translation model designed to provide reliable and accurate translation from Nigerian Languages (Yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa) to English. Developed by HelpMum, the model leverages natural language processing techniques and transfer learning to support low-resource Nigerian languages in software applications.
